entries.source:
In my dreams, I saw the inside of the pits. How the hatchlings devoured each other in a cannibalistic frenzy, how the weak and frail ones were dragged underneath the surface of that mass of tentacles... All I could do is gape in horror. But there was one fiendish shape which towered above them all, a nightmarish fusion between dragon and tentacle... I could not bear to look at it, yet I could not look away. It whispered to me, speaking words that a mortal's tongue could never hope to mimic.

I am not the only one who has been dreaming about the pits. One of my men was hysterical today, whispering about the black gulfs of space and how it has chosen its vessel to conquer this world. He had to be forcefully sedated. 

Whatever is here is touching our minds. Any fool could guess that. I woke up to find that I had been writing notes in my sleep. I do not wish to guess what unspeakable blasphemies these symbols represent. It wants me to keep writing. It wants me to do its bidding. I can feel its whispers gnawing at the back of my head. We must act while we can still think for ourselves. I dread what will become of us if we succumb to the whispers... The whispers. They won't stop.

[i](He appears to have attached those notes he mentioned to this letter. What you see is a series of incomprehensible scribbles and symbols which don't resemble any language you have seen before. Such an bizarre script could have only been produced by a madman or something that thinks in ways completely alien to your own.)[/i]
entries.target:
在我的梦中，我看到了坑的内部。那些幼龙疯狂地互相吞噬，弱小的个体被拖入那团触手之下……我只能惊恐地张大嘴巴。但有一个魔鬼般的身影高耸于它们之上，那是龙与触手噩梦般的融合体……我不忍看它，却又无法移开视线。它朝我发出不可名状的低语，那是凡人永远无法模仿的语言。

我不是唯一一个梦见那些坑的人。我手下的一名士兵今天突然变得歇斯底里，低声念叨着太空中的黑暗深渊，以及它如何选中容器来征服这个世界。我们不得不强行让他镇静下来。

这里的某种东西正在影响我们的思想，连傻瓜都能猜到。我醒来时，发现自己竟在睡梦中写下了笔记。我不想猜测这种符号到底代表了什么难以言喻的亵渎。它想要让我继续写下去，想要我成为它的棋子。我能感到它的低语在脑后啃噬…趁我们还能独立思考，必须采取行动。我不敢想象，如果我们屈服于这些低语，会落得什么下场……那些低语，是永远不会停止的。

[i]（他似乎把提到的那些笔记附在了这封信上。你看到的是一系列不可理解的涂鸦和符号，它们与你之前看到的任何语言都不相似。这样怪异的文字，如果不是来自某个疯子之手，就一定出自某种思维方式与你截然不同的存在。）[/i]

entries.source:
My dear %s,

You have come a long way since the days we met. I am proud of you.
I have #{italic}#"found"#{normal}# a strange glyph sequence that to me looks like some kind of code. I have all faith you can figure out its meaning and hopefully use it to further our cause.

%s


Good luck on your future #{italic}#acquisitions of properties#{normal}#.
entries.target:
亲爱的%s，

从上次我们相见以来你成长了很多。我为你感到非常骄傲。
我最近#{italic}#“找到了”#{normal}#一些奇怪的符号序列，看上去像是某种密码。我相信你一定能解明其含义，希望你能利用它推进我们的事业。

%s


祝你#{italic}#追寻财富#{normal}#的旅途一帆风顺。
